Joins Montgomery tracts to EPA ECHO facility counts and CDC adult asthma prevalence, computes facilities per 1,000 residents, and returns the cross-tract correlation and paired tract count ordered by facility density descending.
sql:
WITH paired AS (
  SELECT
    t.name AS tract_name,
    COALESCE(n.n, 0) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(CAST(h.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE), 0) AS epa_echo_facilities_per_1000_residents,
    COALESCE(n.n, 0) AS epa_echo_facility_count,
    CAST(h.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
    CAST(h.casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_prevalence_percentage,
    t.geoid
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts n
    ON n.geoid = t.geoid
    AND n.run_id = 'r_20261027_8e48a0'
    AND n.source = 'm1_cdc'
    AND n.grp = 'all'
  LEFT JOIN session.fw_8e48a0_m2_cdc h
    ON h.tractfips = t.geoid
  WHERE h.casthma_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(h.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) > 0
)
SELECT
  tract_name,
  epa_echo_facilities_per_1000_residents,
  epa_echo_facility_count,
  totalpopulation,
  adult_asthma_prevalence_percentage,
  CORR(epa_echo_facilities_per_1000_residents, adult_asthma_prevalence_percentage) OVER () AS rate_prevalence_correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY epa_echo_facilities_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, tract_name
LIMIT 200
